Best pho
Aug 2026 • Family
We have been loyal customers of this amazing cafe for 3 years now. We first discovered it during our trip to Da Lat, and we absolutely fell in love with their food and welcoming atmosphere. It quickly became our favorite spot there!We were so thrilled to find out that they opened a branch in Ho Chi Minh City. We just visited this Saigon location, and it is just as fantastic! The taste is exactly as incredible as we remember, bringing the true essence of Da Lat right here. The quality and service remain top-notch. Highly recommend to everyone, we will definitely keep coming back with our family!
